newsitem.title: USA: AAR to buy Cooper Aviation.
newsitem.headline: AAR to buy Cooper Aviation.

text.p: AAR Corp said it signed a definitive agreement to acquire Cooper Aviation Industries Inc for an undisclosed purchase price.
Cooper, located in Elk Grove Village, Ill., is a large distributor of factory-new aviation parts and accessories to the commercial, regional/commuter and general aviation markets.
In the most recent twelve-month period, Cooper posted sales of approximately $45 million, AAR said.

AAR said Cooper Aviation will be integrated into its airframe parts inventory provisioning and management unit and will do business as AAR Cooper Aviation. The business will continue to be led by Martin Cooper, president and current part owner.
AAR supplies aerospace/aviation products and services.
